notes: Active selectable component balance sheet and runtime source of truth for client and server balance.
Hidden legacy size variants are intentionally omitted from this file and from the palette.
Edit component values here; server.js normalizes this file into runtime PARTS and the native ES-module frontend loads the same file for UI stats.
Units: cost $, mass T, hull HP, power MW, shield SP, shieldRegen SP/s, thrust kN, energy MJ, repair HP/s, range m, radius m, projectileSpeed m/s.

Section units: currency $, mass tonnes, hull HP, shield points, seconds, metres, metres/second, radians/second, damage, shots/second, energy, heat, percentages as 0-1 fractions, multipliers as direct factors.

Missile weapon fields are base damage, fire rate, projectile speed, guidance/tracking strength, tracking delay, tracking duration, lifetime where present, firing arc, and accuracy; ordinary theoretical DPS is damage * projectile count per shot * fireRate, while spinalCharge weapons use an ideal cycle that includes mandatory charge time.

weapon.pelletCount / weapon.pelletSpreadDegrees turn one trigger pull into several independent projectiles inside an extra cone; weapon.damage is per pellet, so armour flat reduction applies to each one.
weapon.blastDamage / blastRadius / innerFullDamageRadius / falloffExponent on an offensive (non-flak) weapon add an impact burst after the direct hit resolves, using the same falloff maths as Flak.
weapon.impactHeatPerDamage is supported on projectile weapons as well as beams; it converts applied damage into Heat inside the struck component.

weapon.spinalCharge turns a railgun-family mount into a charge-then-fire spinal weapon: it must hold a firing solution for chargeSeconds, keeps its charge for chargeHoldSeconds after losing one, loses traverse authority past committedAimStartProgress, and applies its damage down the impact ray using penetrationProfile.
burstCooler dumps burstHeat from its own store the moment its heat ratio reaches triggerHeatRatio, then cools at only rechargeCoolingFraction of its rating for rechargeSeconds.
heatBeamShield marks a structural component that induction Heat beams cannot pass through.

fighter.label: Fighter
fighter.intendedUse: Attacks the parent ship's target and nearby hostile drones.

defence.label: Defence
defence.intendedUse: Guards the parent ship and prioritises hostile drones.

repair.label: Repair
repair.intendedUse: Repairs the parent ship, then nearby friendly ships.

components.name: Core
components.description: Required primary command core with strong durability and light built-in Power generation.

components.name: Backup Command Core
components.description: Redundant command centre that takes control if the main Core is destroyed. While active, weapon accuracy, turn rate and drone command range operate at 85%. Also projects a command aura that improves nearby allied weapon accuracy and tracking.

components.name: Armor
components.description: Heavy armour with high hull durability and strong flat damage reduction, at the cost of mass and turn rate.

components.name: Composite Armor
components.description: Lighter armour with good hull durability and moderate flat damage reduction, trading protection for lower mass and turn penalty.

components.name: Frame
components.description: Cheap structure used to expand the ship shape and connect modules.

components.name: Half Armor
components.description: Triangular armor piece for tapered ship edges. Occupies one cell and provides 50% of the standard armor block's stats.

components.name: Half Composite Armor
components.description: Triangular composite armor piece for tapered ship edges. Occupies one cell and provides 50% of the standard composite armor block's stats.

components.name: Half Frame
components.description: Triangular structural piece for tapered ship edges. Occupies one cell with reduced durability and mass compared with a full Frame.

components.name: Wing Armor
components.description: Tapered armor panel used to create wing-like silhouettes. Lighter than a full armor block.

components.name: Wing Composite Armor
components.description: Tapered composite armor panel used to create wing-like silhouettes. Lighter than a full composite armor block.

components.name: Wing Frame
components.description: Tapered frame panel used to create wing-like silhouettes. Lighter than a full frame block.

components.name: Bevel Armour
components.description: A square armour panel with one corner clipped for tapered edges.

components.name: Bevel Composite Armour
components.description: A lighter composite panel with one corner clipped for tapered edges.

components.name: Bevel Frame
components.description: A cheap structural panel with one corner clipped for tapered edges.

components.name: Rounded Armour
components.description: A square armour panel with one outer corner rounded off.

components.name: Rounded Composite Armour
components.description: A lighter composite panel with one outer corner rounded off.

components.name: Rounded Frame
components.description: A cheap structural panel with one outer corner rounded off.

components.name: Long Wedge Armour
components.description: A long two-cell armour wedge with a broad rear and a pointed nose.

components.name: Long Wedge Composite Armour
components.description: A long two-cell composite wedge with a broad rear and a pointed nose.

components.name: Long Wedge Frame
components.description: A long two-cell frame wedge with a broad rear and a pointed nose.

components.name: Ablative Plating
components.description: Layered sacrificial plating with the highest raw hull integrity of any single cell, but no flat damage reduction. Effective against heavy individual hits, but vulnerable to rapid low-damage weapons.

components.name: Half Ablative Plating
components.description: Triangular sacrificial plating for tapered ship edges. Occupies one cell and provides 50% of the standard Ablative Plating block's stats.

components.name: Wing Ablative Plating
components.description: Tapered sacrificial plating used to create wing-like silhouettes. Lighter than a full Ablative Plating block.

components.name: Bevel Ablative Plating
components.description: A square sacrificial plating panel with one corner clipped for tapered edges.

components.name: Rounded Ablative Plating
components.description: A sacrificial plating panel with one outer corner rounded off.

components.name: Long Wedge Ablative Plating
components.description: A long two-cell sacrificial plating wedge with a broad rear and a pointed nose.

components.name: Refractory Armour
components.description: Heat-resistant armour with high thermal capacity and moderate physical protection. It absorbs large amounts of Heat and completely blocks Thermal Induction Lance coupling through the plate.

components.name: Half Refractory Armour
components.description: Triangular Refractory Armour piece for tapered ship edges. Occupies one cell and provides 50% of the standard Refractory Armour block's stats, including half its thermal mass. It still blocks induction Heat beams outright.

components.name: Wing Refractory Armour
components.description: Tapered Refractory Armour panel used to create wing-like silhouettes. Lighter than a full block and carries proportionally less thermal mass, but still blocks induction Heat beams outright.

components.name: Bevel Refractory Armour
components.description: A square Refractory Armour panel with one corner clipped for tapered edges. It still blocks induction Heat beams outright.

components.name: Rounded Refractory Armour
components.description: A Refractory Armour panel with one outer corner rounded off. It still blocks induction Heat beams outright.

components.name: Long Wedge Refractory Armour
components.description: A long two-cell Refractory Armour wedge with a broad rear and a pointed nose. Its enormous thermal mass makes it the natural prow for a ship expecting Heat weapons, and it blocks induction Heat beams outright.

components.name: Aux Generator
components.description: Compact backup generator for light power deficits. Generates a little heat under load and, like all generators, melts down if kept overheated.

components.name: Battery
components.description: Efficient emergency Power reserve. Charges from spare generation and automatically supports the ship during Power shortages.

components.name: Capacitor
components.description: High-output combat reserve. Delivers large bursts of Power for a short duration, but charges less efficiently and produces substantial Heat.

components.name: Reactor
components.description: Primary power source for weapons, shields, engines, and support systems. Generates heat in proportion to load; if it stays pinned at overheat it melts down and explodes, damaging nearby components.

components.name: Nuclear Reactor
components.description: Six-tile capital reactor with enormous Power output and extreme Heat generation under load. It requires a dedicated Heat network and causes a reactor meltdown if left overheated.

components.name: Engine
components.description: Main propulsion module that provides thrust for speed and acceleration. Always faces forward and exhausts rearward. Provides modest turning assistance; add Maneuver Thrusters for stronger control.

components.name: Compact Engine
components.description: Compact one-cell main engine for small hulls and distributed propulsion. Easier to place and protect separately, but provides less thrust than a standard Engine.

components.name: Heavy Engine
components.description: Capital-scale main drive. It provides a large authored thrust value, but it is enormously heavy and its six-cell block must sit in one place, so only large hulls can carry it well.

components.name: Gyroscope
components.description: Stabilizer that improves turn rate without adding thrust.

components.name: Small Sensor
components.description: Compact omnidirectional sensor. Each live Small Sensor adds its full authored range bonus to the general coverage total.

components.name: Large Sensor
components.description: Powerful omnidirectional sensor. Each live Large Sensor adds its full authored range bonus to the general coverage total.

components.name: Small Directed Sensor
components.description: Compact directional sensor covering a forward cone. Each live Small Directed Sensor adds its full authored range bonus where its cone overlaps.

components.name: Large Directed Sensor
components.description: Long-range directional sensor covering a narrow forward cone. Each live Large Directed Sensor adds its full authored range bonus where its cone overlaps.

components.name: Maneuver Thruster
components.description: Directional control thruster that provides strong turning torque. Turning effectiveness increases when placed farther from the ship's centre of mass.

components.name: Aegis Projector
components.description: High-Power shield projector built around rapid regeneration. Provides a strong defensive field and restores it far faster than a standard Shield, but consumes much more Power and space.

components.name: Shield
components.description: Active shield generator. Shields absorb 95% of damage they block. 5% leaks through to hull. Different weapons may deal more or less damage to shields and hull.

components.name: Autocannon
components.description: Rapid-fire close-range kinetic weapon. High fire rate and spread make it effective against exposed hull and light targets, but it performs poorly against shields.

components.name: Beam Emitter
components.description: Sustained beam that excels against shields and heats the component it strikes. Continuous contact ramps its damage, and excess damage can carry through one destroyed component.

components.name: Thermal Induction Lance
components.description: Targeting Priority: Prioritises functioning Power generators when available, then other active systems. The Lance is designed to overload critical powered systems rather than choose targets like an ordinary weapon. Zero-damage induction beam that injects Heat into a target component and nearby components. Sustained contact increases Heat transfer; shields reduce coupling, while Refractory Armour can block the beam.

components.name: Blaster
components.description: Medium-range general-purpose gun with steady damage.

components.name: Missile
components.description: Guided missile launcher with long reach, moderate tracking and a slow reload. Missiles can be intercepted before impact.

components.name: Railgun
components.description: Long-range precision kinetic weapon with heavy hull damage, excellent accuracy and a narrow firing arc.

components.name: Plasma Cannon
components.description: Fires a slow plasma projectile that deals direct damage and injects substantial Heat into the component it strikes. Powerful against thermal-sensitive systems, but easier to dodge at long range.

components.name: EMP Cannon
components.description: Slow, wide unguided pulse that removes 50% of a target maximum Shield per impact, clamped to its current Shield. It deals no hull damage and creates no Shield Impact Heat.

components.name: Fragmentation Cannon
components.description: Impact shell that combines a modest direct hit with an area fragmentation burst. Effective against exposed components and clustered light ships, but weak against shields.

components.name: Scatter Cannon
components.description: Short-range spread weapon that fires six low-damage pellets per shot. Strong against lightly protected hull, but flat armour reduction applies separately to every pellet.

components.name: Spinal Accelerator
components.description: Capital-scale spinal kinetic weapon limited to one per ship. Charges visibly before firing a devastating penetrating shot, progressively restricting only its own weapon traverse while leaving hull turning unaffected.

components.name: Swarm Pod
components.description: Rapid guided-missile pod that fires frequent lightweight missiles with strong tracking. Pressures point defence through sustained volume rather than heavy individual hits.

components.name: Torpedo
components.description: Heavy long-range missile with poor tracking and very high hull damage. Slow and vulnerable to interception, but dangerous against large or sluggish ships.

components.name: Fire Control
components.description: Weapon coordinator that improves fire rate.

components.name: Heat Pipe
components.description: Rapidly transfers Heat between components on the same coolant network. It provides no cooling and stores almost no Heat. Pipes connect automatically to orthogonal neighbours and need no rotation.

components.name: Heat Sink
components.description: Stores large amounts of Heat for buffering thermal spikes. It provides very little cooling, and its capacity belongs only to the sink itself. Connect it to hot systems with Heat Pipes.

components.name: Heat Vent
components.description: Cheap passive Heat rejection that requires an exposed edge. Much weaker than a Radiator, but compact, lightweight and requires no Power.

components.name: Radiator
components.description: Strong passive external Heat rejection. Requires an exposed edge for full output and falls to 25% cooling when fully enclosed.

components.name: Closed-Cycle Cooler
components.description: Powered internal cooling that removes Heat without requiring hull exposure. Reliable anywhere in the ship, but Power-hungry and weaker than a fully exposed Radiator.

components.name: Burst Cooler
components.description: Cryogenic accumulator for sudden Heat spikes. Automatically dumps stored Heat when it reaches its trigger threshold, then provides only weak cooling while it recharges.

components.name: Repair
components.description: Small support module that slowly repairs hull over time.

components.name: Overclocked Repair Unit
components.description: Forced-cycle field fabricator that restores hull three times faster than a standard Repair module. It draws heavy Power, has very little thermal mass of its own, and so climbs to Hot quickly unless it is tied into a real Heat network.

components.name: Drone Bay
components.description: Launches and rebuilds a selected squad of Fighter, Defence or Repair drones. When alive and not Overheated, any positive Power keeps the bay operational; production and launch cadence scale linearly with allocated Power, while 0 Power stops both. Squad size, fuel duration and rebuild time depend on the selected drone type. Requires one completely exposed two-cell launch edge.

components.name: Repair Beam
components.description: Directional support beam that projects hull repair onto a damaged allied ship in range.

components.name: Targeting Computer
components.description: Support computer that improves weapon accuracy.

components.name: Signal Amplifier
components.description: Support transmitter that extends weapon range.

components.name: Stabilizer Node
components.description: Support stabilizer that improves accuracy and slightly helps turning.

components.name: Decoy Launcher
components.description: Launches a limited supply of visible false targets against incoming guided missiles. Production speed scales linearly with allocated Power; any positive Power allows a launch when other conditions are met, while 0 Power stops production and launching. Each decoy has a chance to attract a guided projectile, is rebuilt over time, and has no effect on unguided weapons.

components.name: Laser Point Defence
components.description: High-Power defensive laser designed to destroy hostile drones and light incoming ordnance. Its hitscan beam cannot miss once aligned, but it deals negligible damage to ships.

components.name: Flak Cannon
components.description: Explosive proximity-fused anti-missile and anti-drone defence. Shells detonate on near-miss, direct impact or at max range, damaging all fragile targets within the blast. Weak single-target hull damage and poor armour penetration; not a replacement for Point Defence or autocannons.

components.name: Interceptor Pod
components.description: Longer-range missile interception. Expensive and weak against ships.

components.name: Fire-Control Command Centre
components.description: Coordinates nearby allied weapon fire, improving accuracy, tracking and turret aim speed.

components.name: Fleet Defence Coordinator
components.description: Improves nearby allied Point Defence and Flak tracking.

components.name: Shield Command Relay
components.description: Improves Shield regeneration and reduces the restart delay after complete Shield depletion for nearby allied ships. Does not increase maximum Shield capacity.

components.name: Engineering Command Centre
components.description: Improves nearby allied repair rate, Heat dissipation and recovery from overheated states.

components.name: Propulsion Command Relay
components.description: Improves the acceleration and turn rate of nearby allied ships. Does not increase top speed.

components.name: Siege Charge
components.description: Heavy kamikaze proximity charge. Armed by default, it detonates when an enemy ship enters the trigger radius. Its blast has quadratic falloff but no component target cap, and damages friendly ships.

components.name: Demolition Charge
components.description: Compact kamikaze charge for attack swarms. Armed by default, it detonates when an enemy enters its trigger radius, damages a limited number of components and does not damage friendly ships.

components.name: Electronic Warfare Command Centre
components.description: Improves nearby allied sensor range, resistance to missile tracking and the ability of weapons to retain precise component targeting.

metadata.purpose: Authoritative gameplay balance source. Units are documented in notes; generated public copy is not manually maintained.

commandAura.notes: Shared command aura radius for all command components. All command circles use this range so players can judge range at a glance.
